grh_7d8c5f20bae307f0f73c.title: Conspiracy at the Golden Gate
paragraphs: In early 1861 San Francisco, secessionists plan to pull California out of the Union, seize the federal mint and Presidio, and divert the state's gold to the new Confederacy. Shipping man Toby Kingston is drawn into the plot and assigned to assist a mysterious colonel whose knowledge of mines and gold transport makes him essential. Toby's friend Bill Sweeter and the colonel's daughter Emily complicate his loyalties, especially when Emily reveals that she had been falsely told her father was dead. As the attack approaches, Toby and Bill help warn Union General Johnston and arrange for father and daughter to escape together. Secessionist leader Hastings discovers the betrayal and holds them at gunpoint, but the colonel overpowers him. Watching the reunited pair sail away, Toby realizes that he has chosen the Union and is grateful California has not been torn away from it.

[[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Anne Gibbon, Ben Wright, Daws Butler, Fletcher Markle, and Len Birman. Other credited names include Fletcher Markle as director, Fletcher Markle as producer, Chris Fortunato as writer, and Lorne Greene as host.
The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.9b0a0ccffce2f7d3|Sears, Roebuck and Company]].
